description: An array of route objects (`path`, `component`, `redirectTo`, `children`, `title`...). The router walks it top to bottom and uses the **first** match.
Registers the router in an `ApplicationConfig` or test providers. Accepts optional features such as `withComponentInputBinding()` or `withPreloading()`.
Placeholder where the router renders the component of the active route. Nested routes need nested outlets.
Directive that navigates without a full page reload. Accepts a string (`'/about'`) or a commands array (`['/users', id]`).
Adds CSS classes while the link's URL is active. `[routerLinkActiveOptions]="{ exact: true }"` requires an exact match.
`{ path: '**', component: NotFound }` matches any URL. It must be the last entry.
